name: Checkbox
description: Selects options that take effect when a form is submitted.

onCheckedChange.description: Called with the next checked state when the user toggles the checkbox

readOnly.description: The checkbox cannot be changed; band fill and a dashed edge

invalid.description: The value fails validation: danger edge on the box and errorMessage under the label

errorMessage.description: Message shown with a warning icon under the label while invalid; wired to aria-describedby

variant.description: Chrome. Omit for the inline checkbox beside its label; 'outline' renders a full-width choice card (surface, hairline, surface radius) whose hairline turns into the selection ring when checked.

helperText.description: Helper text shown below the label

aria-label.description: Accessible label when there is no visible label

aria-labelledby.description: Accessible labelled-by relationship when there is no visible label

when: Choices that apply only once the form is submitted
Picking several items from a list
whenNot: One choice from a few (use RadioGroup)
guidelines: Add helperText when the consequence is not obvious
Use indeterminate for a parent whose children are partly checked
Pair invalid with an errorMessage; the danger edge alone is colour only
accessibility: Label is tied to the box
The error message is wired to aria-describedby and carries an icon and words

examples.name: Default
examples.description: One box, one label, off to start.

examples.name: With Helper Text
examples.description: Second line spells out what opting in does.
examples.code:
<StatefulCheckbox
  label="Email notifications"
  helperText="Receive email updates about your account activity"
/>

examples.name: Indeterminate
examples.description: A dash on the parent means only some children are on.

examples.name: Disabled
examples.description: Locked in both positions, on and off.

examples.name: Invalid
examples.description: A danger edge on the box and a message with an icon under the label.
examples.code:
<Checkbox
  label="I accept the terms"
  invalid
  errorMessage="Accept the terms to continue."
/>

examples.name: Outline Card
examples.description: The whole card picks; checked turns its hairline into the selection ring.
examples.code:
<StatefulCheckbox
  variant="outline"
  label="Weekly summary"
  helperText="One email on Monday morning."
/>

relations.note: Checkbox handles boolean; Input handles text

propsSummary: readOnly: boolean - locked value, band fill and dashed edge
invalid: boolean - danger edge; pair with errorMessage
errorMessage: node - message with an icon under the label while invalid
variant: outline - full-width choice card; omit for the inline control
